title: Live Update 1.39.0
body:
# Live Update 1.39.0

Hello Raiders! Live Update 1.39.0 is rolling out now, delivering a range of game fixes, changes and further updates to the Matchmaking System. The Seeker and Wolfpack no longer deal inconsistent damage, and trinkets that were added back in 1.33.0 can now stack. On top of that, a new Dweller Outfit is available in the store.

## **Matchmaking Update: Testing Defensive PvP**

Improving matchmaking has been a major focus for us over the last several months. We have made a number of adjustments and improvements in response to your feedback and requests. Since our notes on The Matchmaking System, one change in particular has resonated with the community: **defending yourself is no longer treated the same as starting a fight.** This meant that self-defense still contributed to your playstyle estimate, but carried much less weight than initiating combat. The response to this has been positive, and many of you have asked us to go further.

The most frequent request we have received is to **eliminate the impact of Defensive PvP altogether** - moving from reduced weight to no weight at all. We are beginning to test exactly that now. During this test, only fights you choose to initiate will affect your playstyle estimate, and defending yourself will have no effect on it whatsoever. This also covers knocking out enemies who attacked first.

So how does the system determine what counts as starting a fight versus defending yourself? Here is how an encounter is interpreted:

* **Who is defending:** If an enemy squad damages, downs, or knocks out any member of your squad first, your entire squad is treated as defending - the squad that strikes first is considered the one that started the fight.

* **How it is weighed:** The more intense the encounter, the more weight it carries. A long, drawn-out firefight involving heavy damage and multiple downs weighs a great deal, while a brief accidental hit or a short exchange where the other squad retreats after minimal damage still counts as starting a fight, but carries much less weight.

* **Third-partying:** Jumping into an ongoing fight between two other squads also counts as starting a fight.

Over the coming weeks, we will be watching our matchmaking metrics closely, observing how PvP evolves Topside, and collecting your feedback.

## **Matchmaking Changes: Follow-up**

Two previous changes remain in effect: the tracking of Solo, Duo, and Trio matchmaking introduced in 1.36.0, and the matchmaking optimization adjustments from 1.38.0. We continue to monitor how both are performing, but telemetry alone only gives us part of the picture - understanding how your matches actually feel requires hearing directly from you.

Thank you to everyone who has completed the matchmaking survey - your input provides the other half of the picture, and it is what allows our data to translate into better decisions. Thank you, Raiders!

## **Reminder - ARC Raiders & THE FINALS Crossover**

Raiders and Contestants, a reminder! You have until 3PM CEST on July 30th to finish the required Contracts in THE FINALS in order to unlock the Azimuth outfit and the Archaeologist Backpack bundle in ARC Raiders.

After that date, we return to the Rust Belt! You will still be able to unlock the Azimuth bundle in THE FINALS by heading Topside and playing ARC Raiders.

# **Bug Fixes & Content Updates**

* Improved the sound of footsteps when moving through water.

* Added more varied and distinct sounds for the Dodge Roll.

* Adjusted the ambient audio used in certain cinematics.

* Fixed mislabeled customization toggles on the Blindspot Set. The "No Headset" toggle now correctly controls the Blindspot headset.

* Updated customization toggles: the Triumph Set now uses a Helmet Only toggle, and the Scorta Set now uses a Gauntlet Off toggle.

* Updated the names of Scorta outfit colors in the UI so they better reflect the actual skin colors.

* Fixed a missing UI string tied to a blue backpack cosmetic.

* Fixed inconsistent damage output from the Seeker Grenade and the Wolfpack Grenade.

* Fixed an issue that could cause the Train model to appear in two locations within the Raider Den even though only one was owned.

* Trinkets introduced with the Converging Paths project now stack the same way other trinkets do, and their drop rates have been adjusted for more consistent looting across all maps.

* Fixed several clipping issues, floating props, holes in the landscape, and locations where players could become stuck on Dam Battlegrounds.

* Fixed multiple collision and clipping issues on Buried City, including invisible obstacles, corrected certain materials, and resolved a spot near an overpass where downed players could become stuck.

* Closed a hole on Buried City that allowed players to use the Snap Hook to leave the map boundaries.

* Fixed an issue that could leave players stuck in the End of Round tunnel after leaving a map.

* Fixed a crash that could occur at startup right after the photosensitive warning screen.

* Polished various pieces of UI text and updated localization across all supported languages.

* Fixed an issue causing item prices above 10,000 to display with incorrect shorthand in the Trader tab when using Japanese or Simplified Chinese.

* Updated localization for Trinket names and ARC terminology throughout the menus.

* Updated the start screen with a new looping background video.

* Fixed an issue where pressing L3 on a gamepad would not toggle the item tooltip on Ermal's Select Items screen, and added a background blur to make it easier to read.

* Updated the Projects list and screens so related Projects are grouped together for easier browsing.

* Updated the Project UI: corrected text, improved previews for multi-phase projects, and Projects now unlock after playing 5 rounds.

* Fixed an issue causing background visuals to update incorrectly.

* Fixed an issue where Projects could fail to move to the next step after a goal was completed, even when the required items had been contributed.

* Improved the Projects Tab with added quest and step descriptions, more consistent text and reward tiles, and restored navigation so completed stages can be reviewed after a project is finished.

* Fixed an issue where the rewards preview for the Trophy Display Raider Project showed a duplicate "Howl" Emote.

* Improved the Expedition and Project UI: grouped projects now only appear when at least one is active, fixed navigation issues in the top bar, and corrected the display of Expedition steps.

* Standardized how timers are displayed across Project and Expedition screens for clearer countdowns.

## **Known Issues**

* We are investigating an ongoing issue where some XBOX players, particularly on Series S, are experiencing crashes.

* The Quick Wheel item selection can sometimes swap to a different item on the Wheel if it is closed and reopened quickly.

* The Dolabra, Hullcracker, and Rascal do not currently deal damage to training dummies on the Practice Range.

* The throw animation can sometimes fail to play when trying to detonate a Trigger 'Nade immediately after throwing it.

* Some gadgets and throwables are missing a "Cancel" button when preparing to throw them.

* The weapon swap animation may look broken if a weapon is swapped right after vaulting.

* Player animations may appear broken when a search of the Baron Husk is interrupted.

* Shredders can float toward the ceiling in some rooms within the Hidden Bunker.

* Leapers are able to jump through the ARC Turbine.

* The pickup sound played when collecting items is sometimes incorrect.

* Items that grant Merits will incorrectly display a Merits icon when brought into a Raid.

* Shots fired while riding ARC may sometimes fail to register properly.

* Some doors allow the beam of a player's flashlight to pass through instead of blocking the light.

* Some hairstyles can clip through the helmet of the Reaver Outfit.

* We are aware of clipping issues affecting the Triumph and Azimuth outfits.

* Old Ermal offers may appear available in the 'Acquire and Craft' menu, though this is visual only.

See you Topside, //Raz and The ARC Raiders Team
